text:
Priya Patel: pagerduty-bot triggered: HIGH severity — 5xx error rate 4.8% on /v1/generate over last 60s (threshold 1%)
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-17921 — routing to on-call Priya Patel
Priya Patel: I'm seeing a flood of alerts for inference-gateway 5xx. Looks correlated with a sudden spike in upstream Redis timeouts.
Alex Kim: confirming, app logs show cache errors + long tail in kv-cache: 
```
ERROR inference.gateway cache get failed: ETIMEDOUT after 50ms
stack: ... redis://10.2.4.5:6379
```
Javier Morales: PD already paged me; I'm on the infra side checking network and redis metrics.
Emily Chen: I'm pausing non-critical rolling deploys and routing more traffic to fallback model variants via the router policy. Switching canary off for now.
Samira Khan: Customer impact report — initial check: 0 customers in SLO breach yet but some streaming sessions showing partial responses. I'll template a quick note if we need comms.
Priya Patel: Javier, how bad is the alert noise? Are alerts deduping properly? I'm getting 12 Slack messages in 3 minutes.
Javier Morales: The alerts are per-host, so 8 pods each emitted separate PD alerts. PD grouping key is not set correctly for the gateway. We're seeing duplicate incidents.
Alex Kim: Can we mute duplicates temporarily? PD has an auto-merge but it's too slow. We should rate-limit the alert webhook for the service and set grouping by alert fingerprint + service.
Priya Patel: I'll add a short-term silencing rule: block repeated PD pages for the same fingerprint for 5m to avoid wakeups. Anyone object? :thinking_face:
Emily Chen: that's fine as a short-term mitigation. We need a permanent fix: change alert rule to use `alert_fingerprint` grouping + increase threshold window to 2m and require >3 hosts before firing.
Javier Morales: working on a quick fix now: updating PrometheusAlertmanager route to group_by: [alertname, service, fingerprint] and set repeat_interval: 5m. Pushing patch to alertmanager config.
Priya Patel: also set a rate limit on the gateway alerts in router: `--alert-rate-limit=10/m` so we don't overload PD.
Samira Khan: drafting the incident summary for customers (if needed). Will wait until we see durable changes.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-17921 acknowledged by Priya Patel
oncall-scheduler-bot: Javier Morales assigned for infra followup (2h)
Javier Morales: Pushed alertmanager change, reloading config now. Diff: 
```
route:
  group_by: ['alertname','service','fingerprint']
  receiver: 'pagerduty'
  repeat_interval: 5m
```
Alex Kim: Applied temporary PromQL change to rule `gateway_5xx_rate`: now `sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5..",job="gateway"}[2m])) by (service) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway"}[2m])) > 0.02 and count by (instance) (rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5..",job="gateway"}[1m]) > 0) > 3`
Priya Patel: Good. I've silenced the PD service for the fingerprint we saw for 5m. If anything new shows up we will still page.
Emily Chen: Router fallback reduced traffic to 70% -> downstream DB and cache errors dropping. 5xx rate down to 0.8% now.
Samira Khan: Noting customer-visible impact: partial responses for < 15 minutes, no successful SLO breaches. Adding to follow-up doc.
Priya Patel: OK team — plan for post-incident: 1) Make alert grouping change permanent and review other services for similar pitfalls. 2) Add a guard to require host-count > 3 for high-cardinality alerts. 3) Add an alertmanager rate-limit policy and PD dedupe keys per-service. 4) Create a dashboard to show alert fanout by host and fingerprint.
Javier Morales: I'll open a tracking ticket and link the alert config diff + CI test. Ticket: INF-4729.
Alex Kim: I'll add integration tests for the alert rule (simulate 5xx from one host vs cluster-wide).
Emily Chen: I'll own the dashboard: `infra/alert-fanout` with panels: alerts per minute, hosts involved, top fingerprints.
Samira Khan: Drafting postmortem blurb and customer note. Will sync tomorrow 10:30 PT with oncall and support.
Priya Patel: Thanks all. Leaving notes in the incident doc. If anything else pops up, escalate in this thread. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-17921 resolved — 5xx rate returned below threshold and PD silences in place.
Priya Patel: marking this thread closed for now, follow-ups tracked in INF-4729 and dashboard ticket.
